title: Past Simple — Regular Verbs
grammarNote:
Past Simple используется для ЗАВЕРШЁННЫХ действий в прошлом.

① Конкретное время в прошлом: "I met her yesterday." · "We arrived last Monday."
② Последовательность: "I woke up, had breakfast, and went to class."
③ Прошлые привычки (уже не актуальные): "We lived in Almaty for three years."

Образование правильных глаголов (regular verbs) → + ed:
work→worked · play→played · study→studied · stop→stopped
⚠️ -e в конце → + d: love→loved · -y → ied: study→studied · удвоение: stop→stopped

Отрицание: Subject + DIDN'T + base form
"She didn't come yesterday." ⚠️ После didn't — BASE FORM без -ed!

Вопрос: DID + Subject + base form?
"Did you call her?" · "Did they arrive on time?"

📌 Сигналы: yesterday · last night/week · in 2020 · ago · when I was... · then

rows.example: walk → walked, talk → talked, visit → visited
live → lived, love → loved, move → moved
study → studied, try → tried, carry → carried

rows.form: Short verb ends in vowel + consonant → double the consonant + ed
rows.example: stop → stopped, plan → planned, drop → dropped
travel → travelled, cancel → cancelled

rows.form: Exception: -y after a vowel → just add -ed
rows.example: play → played, stay → stayed, enjoy → enjoyed
I visited the museum yesterday.

rows.form: last night / last week / last year
rows.example: She studied last night. He moved last year.
They lived there 50 years ago. She called 5 minutes ago.
Pushkin visited Uralsk in 1833. She graduated in 1966.
When I was young, I walked to school every day.
We travelled at the weekend. She called on Monday.

rows.form: Rule: subject + did not (didn't) + BASE form
rows.example: She didn't study → NOT "She didn't studied"

rows.form: He / She / It: same as I / You / We / They
rows.example: He didn't play. She didn't walk. It didn't work.
didn't = did not (used in speech and informal writing)
He no walked. ✗ → He didn't walk. ✓
She didn't walked. ✗ → She didn't walk. ✓
She did NOT study — she played all day.

grammarExtra.title: Question Form: Did + subject + BASE FORM?

rows.example: Did she study? Did they live here? Did you walk?
Yes, she did. / No, she didn't. / Yes, I did. / No, I didn't.

rows.form: Wh- questions: Wh- word + did + subject + BASE form
rows.example: Where did she study? When did they move? Why did he stop?
Did she studied? ✗ → Did she study? ✓
Who visited Uralsk? → Pushkin did. (NOT: Who did visit?)
How long did she teach? — For forty years.

grammarTip:
После DIDN'T и DID всегда BASE FORM (без -ed)!
❌ "I didn't went." → ✅ "I didn't go."
❌ "Did she came?" → ✅ "Did she come?"

Логика: did/didn't уже несёт прошедшее время — глагол остаётся базовым.

Утверждение: I went · She called
Отрицание: I didn't GO · She didn't CALL
Вопрос: Did I go? · Did she call?

Краткие ответы: "Did you see her?" → "Yes, I did." / "No, I didn't."

questions.text: She ___ in Uralsk all her life.
questions.hint: Past Simple positive: subject + verb + ed.
Negative Past Simple: didn't + BASE form (walk).

questions.text: ___ you study English at school? — Yes, I ___.
questions.hint: Question: Did + subject + base form. Short answer: Yes, I did.
study → y after consonant → change to -ied.

questions.text: He ___ (stop) the car and got out.
questions.hint: stop: short verb, ends in CVC → double the final consonant → stopped.

questions.text: "She didn't lived there" is correct Past Simple.
questions.hint: After 'didn't', use BASE form: 'She didn't live there.'
Use "in" with years in Past Simple.

questions.text: Where ___ she ___ (live) when she was a child?
questions.hint: Wh- question: Where + did + subject + BASE form.
Question form: Did + subject + BASE form (no -ed).

questions.text: They ___ (play) outside until it got dark.
questions.hint: play → vowel + y → just add -ed → played.

questions.text: "ago" is used with Past Simple (e.g., "2 years ago").
questions.hint: "Ago" always goes with Past Simple: "She moved here 10 years ago."

questions.text: She ___ (not / miss) school even in winter.
questions.hint: Past Simple negative: didn't + BASE form.

questions.text: ___ Dr. Akhmetov explain the history of Uralsk?
questions.hint: Past Simple question: Did + subject + base form.

questions.text: She ___ (try) to understand the old Cyrillic writing.
questions.hint: try → y after consonant → change to -ied → tried.

questions.text: The museum guide ___ (travel) to Almaty last month.
questions.hint: travel → ends in consonant -l → double l → travelled (British English).

questions.text: "Who visited Uralsk?" uses "did" in the question.
questions.hint: When "who" is the subject, do NOT use "did": "Who visited Uralsk?" = Pushkin visited.
